observation_metadata.annotation_scope: Annotation keys describe this observation representation, not keys claimed to exist in the source.
observation_metadata.boundary_rule: At the source root and every payload container, keep object keys but traverse only sample, conditions, and container-valued payload; omit every other member. Non-object boundary scalars are omitted and boundary arrays retain element order.
observation_metadata.character_accounting: returned_canonical_characters counts canonical_json(observation) only, excluding this metadata and the outer inspection record.
observation_metadata.omission_rule: Omit the contents of per_query and provenance at every depth and retain only their whole-value type.
observation_metadata.retained_branch_rule: Within sample/conditions, retain keys and array positions; mask scalars with exact JSON types, retaining observed_value only for an immediate string-valued id member. Array elements do not inherit the id exception.
